name: After § 13
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 13c. Recalls, moreover, the situation at the Polish-Belarusian border, where Poland was confronted with a coordinated hybrid operation by the Belarusian regime involving the deliberate instrumentalisation of migration as a means of political pressure and destabilisation; deplores the fact that legitimate measures taken by Poland to protect the EU’s external border were repeatedly portrayed by certain EU institutions, political actors and publicly funded organisations primarily through false allegations of human rights violations, while insufficient attention was paid to the responsibility of the regimes in Minsk and Moscow; warns that such one-sided narratives risk undermining the security efforts of frontline Member States and can be exploited by hostile actors as part of broader disinformation and destabilisation campaigns;
